name: BrutalCore(LVL2,TIMER)
author: somethingjemail
description: BrutalCore is my first game anyways, BrutalCore is hard and if you die you have to start over. However if you just want to experince the game's content with no risk press tab after clicking play. Then toggle invincibility on. The goal is to complete the two levels and doing so you stop the robots from launching a rocket, this rocket if launched would spell the end of humanity. (I know generic) If you're wondering why a duck is the picture, I like ducks that's why. Any feedback is greatly appreciated thank you for reading this and have a great time.
